xwikidoc.title: Personal Pages macros
xwikidoc.content:
{{velocity output="false"}} ## Shared code of the Personal Pages application, included by the hub, the "My pages" drawer entry, the user profile ## section and the administration section. Variables set by these macros are prefixed with "pp".
## Loads the administration settings into $ppLocation, $ppLocationRef, $ppParentSpaces, $ppReaders, $ppOwnerRights and ## $ppReaderGroups. They live on PersonalPages.Code.Configuration, a "configuration" XAR entry: installed with the ## defaults, never touched by upgrades, and readable by administrators only (hence getDocumentAsAuthor). #macro (ppLoadSettings) #set ($ppLocation = 'PersonalPages.WebHome') #set ($ppReaders = 'loggedIn') #set ($ppOwnerRights = ['edit', 'delete']) #set ($ppReaderGroups = []) #set ($ppSettingsRef = $services.model.createDocumentReference('', ['PersonalPages', 'Code'], 'Configuration')) #set ($ppSettingsObj = $xwiki.getDocumentAsAuthor($ppSettingsRef).getObject('PersonalPages.Code.ConfigurationClass')) #if ($ppSettingsObj) #if ("$!ppSettingsObj.getValue('location').trim()" != '') #set ($ppLocation = $ppSettingsObj.getValue('location').trim()) #end #set ($ppConfiguredReaders = "$!ppSettingsObj.getValue('readers')") #if ($ppConfiguredReaders == 'owner' || $ppConfiguredReaders == 'groups') #set ($ppReaders = $ppConfiguredReaders) #end ## Only known right names are accepted; list values may come back as a list or as a separated string. #set ($ppRawRights = $ppSettingsObj.getValue('ownerRights')) #if ("$!ppRawRights" != '' && !$ppRawRights.iterator()) #set ($ppRawRights = $ppRawRights.split('[,|]')) #end #set ($ppKnownRights = ['edit', 'comment', 'delete', 'admin']) #set ($ppConfiguredRights = []) #foreach ($ppRight in $ppRawRights) #set ($ppRight = $ppRight.trim()) #if ($ppKnownRights.contains($ppRight) && !$ppConfiguredRights.contains($ppRight)) #set ($discard = $ppConfiguredRights.add($ppRight)) #end #end #if (!$ppConfiguredRights.isEmpty()) #set ($ppOwnerRights = $ppConfiguredRights) #end #set ($ppRawGroups = $ppSettingsObj.getValue('readerGroups')) #if ("$!ppRawGroups" != '' && !$ppRawGroups.iterator()) #set ($ppRawGroups = $ppRawGroups.split('[,|]')) #end #foreach ($ppGroup in $ppRawGroups) #if ("$!ppGroup.trim()" != '') #set ($discard = $ppReaderGroups.add($ppGroup.trim())) #end #end #end ## New personal pages are children of the location page: under its space for a WebHome, under the page otherwise. #set ($ppLocationRef = $services.model.resolveDocument($ppLocation)) #set ($ppParentSpaces = []) #foreach ($ppSpaceRef in $ppLocationRef.spaceReferences) #set ($discard = $ppParentSpaces.add($ppSpaceRef.name)) #end #if ($ppLocationRef.name != 'WebHome') #set ($discard = $ppParentSpaces.add($ppLocationRef.name)) #end #end
## A user as stored in rights rules and markers: "XWiki.bob" for a user of this wiki, "xwiki:XWiki.bob" for a user of ## another wiki (e.g. a main-wiki user in a subwiki). Sets $ppUserString. #macro (ppUserString $ppUserRef) #set ($ppUserString = $services.model.serialize($ppUserRef, 'compactwiki')) #end
## Where the personal pages of a user are created with the current settings. Sets $ppHomeRef and $ppHomeSpaces. #macro (ppHomeRef $ppUserRef) #set ($ppHomeSpaces = []) #set ($discard = $ppHomeSpaces.addAll($ppParentSpaces)) #set ($discard = $ppHomeSpaces.add($ppUserRef.name)) #set ($ppHomeRef = $services.model.createDocumentReference('', $ppHomeSpaces, 'WebHome')) #end
## Finds the personal pages of a user, wherever they were created. Sets $ppFound (a document reference) or null. ## Owners can edit the marker on their own pages, so a candidate only counts when ## * its creator is the user (created with the button) or an administrator (created by the administration action): ## users cannot change who created a page, and ## * it sits in a space named after the user, which is where personal pages are always created: otherwise the owner ## of an administrator-created page could point its marker at another user and take over their "My pages". #macro (ppFindPages $ppUserRef) #set ($ppFound = $NULL) #ppUserString($ppUserRef) #set ($ppCandidates = $services.query.xwql('from doc.object(PersonalPages.Code.PersonalPageClass) as marker where marker.owner = :owner').bindValue('owner', $ppUserString).setLimit(20).execute()) #foreach ($ppCandidate in $ppCandidates) #if (!$ppFound) #set ($ppCandidateDoc = $xwiki.getDocumentAsAuthor($ppCandidate)) #set ($ppCreatorRef = $ppCandidateDoc.creatorReference) #if ($ppCandidateDoc.documentReference.lastSpaceReference.name == $ppUserRef.name && ($ppCreatorRef == $ppUserRef || $services.security.authorization.hasAccess('admin', $ppCreatorRef, $services.wiki.currentWikiReference))) #set ($ppFound = $ppCandidateDoc.documentReference) #end #end #end #end
## Creates the personal pages of a user (call #ppLoadSettings first). With $ppAsUser the home page is saved as the ## current user (the button); otherwise as the script author, an administrator (the administration action). ## Sets $ppCreated (the home page reference) or $ppBlocked (the page that is in the way). #macro (ppCreate $ppUserRef $ppAsUser) #set ($ppCreated = $NULL) #set ($ppBlocked = $NULL) #ppUserString($ppUserRef) #ppHomeRef($ppUserRef) #if (!$xwiki.getDocumentAsAuthor($ppHomeRef).isNew()) #set ($ppBlocked = $ppHomeRef) #else ## 1. Rights, saved as the script author because users cannot edit rights themselves. Read access is granted ## explicitly (never inherited), so personal pages do not depend on the permissions of the location page. ## Levels are stored without spaces ("view,edit"): the rights checker does not trim them. #set ($ppLevels = []) #if ($ppReaders != 'loggedIn') #set ($discard = $ppLevels.add('view')) #end #set ($discard = $ppLevels.addAll($ppOwnerRights)) #set ($ppReaderRuleGroups = []) #if ($ppReaders == 'loggedIn') #set ($discard = $ppReaderRuleGroups.add('XWiki.XWikiAllGroup')) ## In a subwiki, users of the main wiki are not members of the subwiki's XWikiAllGroup. #if ($services.wiki.currentWikiId != $services.wiki.mainWikiId) #set ($discard = $ppReaderRuleGroups.add("${services.wiki.mainWikiId}:XWiki.XWikiAllGroup")) #end #elseif ($ppReaders == 'groups') #set ($discard = $ppReaderRuleGroups.addAll($ppReaderGroups)) #end #set ($ppPrefsRef = $services.model.createDocumentReference('', $ppHomeSpaces, 'WebPreferences')) #set ($ppPrefs = $xwiki.getDocumentAsAuthor($ppPrefsRef)) ## Replace (never add to) existing rules, so a retry after a failed attempt cannot leave duplicates. #set ($discard = $ppPrefs.removeObjects('XWiki.XWikiGlobalRights')) #set ($ppOwnerRule = $ppPrefs.newObject('XWiki.XWikiGlobalRights')) #set ($discard = $ppOwnerRule.set('users', $ppUserString)) #set ($discard = $ppOwnerRule.set('groups', '')) #set ($discard = $ppOwnerRule.set('levels', $stringtool.join($ppLevels, ','))) #set ($discard = $ppOwnerRule.set('allow', 1)) #if (!$ppReaderRuleGroups.isEmpty()) #set ($ppReaderRule = $ppPrefs.newObject('XWiki.XWikiGlobalRights')) #set ($discard = $ppReaderRule.set('users', '')) #set ($discard = $ppReaderRule.set('groups', $stringtool.join($ppReaderRuleGroups, ','))) #set ($discard = $ppReaderRule.set('levels', 'view')) #set ($discard = $ppReaderRule.set('allow', 1)) #end #set ($discard = $ppPrefs.setHidden(true)) #set ($discard = $ppPrefs.saveAsAuthor($services.localization.render('personalpages.save.rights'))) ## 2. The home page. Fetched only now: the rights saved above are what let the user see and edit it. #if ($ppAsUser) #set ($ppHomeDoc = $xwiki.getDocument($ppHomeRef)) #else #set ($ppHomeDoc = $xwiki.getDocumentAsAuthor($ppHomeRef)) #end #set ($ppNl = $util.newline) ## The welcome texts come from the admin-controlled translations and are inserted as wiki markup. #set ($ppHeading = $services.localization.render('personalpages.page.heading')) #set ($ppIntro = $services.localization.render("personalpages.page.intro.$ppReaders")) ## The display name is user-controlled, and XWiki evaluates Velocity in titles with the rights of the page's content ## author (the administrator when the bulk action creates the page). Escape it the way XWiki's own create page ## dialog does, so that $ and # are displayed, never executed. #set ($ppDisplayName = $escapetool.velocity($xwiki.getPlainUserName($ppUserRef))) #set ($discard = $ppHomeDoc.setTitle($services.localization.render('personalpages.page.title', [$ppDisplayName]))) #set ($discard = $ppHomeDoc.setSyntaxId('xwiki/2.1')) #set ($discard = $ppHomeDoc.setContent("= $ppHeading =$ppNl$ppNl$ppIntro$ppNl$ppNl{{children/}}$ppNl")) #set ($ppMarker = $ppHomeDoc.newObject('PersonalPages.Code.PersonalPageClass')) #set ($discard = $ppMarker.set('owner', $ppUserString)) #if ($ppAsUser) #set ($discard = $ppHomeDoc.save($services.localization.render('personalpages.save.created'))) #else #set ($discard = $ppHomeDoc.saveAsAuthor($services.localization.render('personalpages.save.createdByAdmin'))) #end #set ($ppCreated = $ppHomeRef) #end #end
## A wiki link to a document, safe for any title or reference. Sets $ppLink. #macro (ppLink $ppLinkRef) #set ($ppLinkDoc = $xwiki.getDocument($ppLinkRef)) #set ($ppLink = "[[$services.rendering.escape($ppLinkDoc.plainTitle, 'xwiki/2.1')>>doc:$services.rendering.escape($services.model.serialize($ppLinkRef, 'local'), 'xwiki/2.1')]]") #end {{/velocity}}
